acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of grout replacement in the Bay Area varies significantly based on several factors, including the area size, the type of tile, the extent of old grout removal required, and the specific type of new grout chosen (e.g., sanded, unsanded, epoxy). Accessibility to the work area also plays a role. For an accurate estimate, it's best to schedule a consultation where a contractor can assess your specific project needs. General pricing might range from $X to $Y per square foot, but this can fluctuate.
